macOS build below is a universal binary (Apple Silicon & Intel), Developer ID signed and notarized — no Gatekeeper warnings. Unzip and drag Podstash.app to /Applications.
## What's Changed - Bump to 0.0.19 - Fix crash on launch from unguarded row index in QueueTableView - Fix Queue thumbnails missing on cold launch and stale queue badge after unsubscribe
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/geoffoliver/podstash/compare/v0.0.18...v0.0.19
